result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: it provides a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid or payable fees and $1,000,000, mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes the Company’s payment obligations from damages. It leaves the original warranty language unchanged and adds only the needed liability framework. Drafting is professional, though the opening “Except for Excluded Claims” could be clarified to state expressly whether the carve-outs apply only to the cap or also to the consequential-damages exclusion.
